## Summary

Describe the change and the reason it is required.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests and linting pass
- [ ] CodeQL, Semgrep and Gitleaks checks pass
- [ ] Dependency and container checks pass where applicable
- [ ] No credentials or sensitive values are included
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes include regression evidence
- [ ] HLD, LLD, API or deployment documentation is updated where required

## Security impact

List affected assets, trust boundaries, authentication/authorisation behavior and residual risks. Write `None` only after considering each item.
